What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of Field engineers in Presales and Professional Services
  • Solve customer problems by promoting technologies and acting as a trusted advisor
  • Work remotely in your time zone
  • Coach, mentor, and provide career development feedback
  • Identify and measure team health indicators
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Represent your team and products to stakeholders, partners, and customers
  • Develop and promote best engineering and organizational practices
  • Plan and manage progress on goals and projects
  • Participate in leadership team collaborations

What we are looking for in you

  • Knowledge of cloud computing concepts & technologies (Kubernetes, Openstack, AWS, GCP, Azure, Ceph)
  • Practical Linux and networking skills
  • Experience in technical presales
  • Dynamic personality, proactive in new projects and interacting with people
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Passion for developing and growing people
  • Experience leading, coaching, and mentoring engineers
  • Organized, ensuring timely, high-quality results
  • Strong academic background
  • Willingness to travel up to 40%, attending events and meetings

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Second language (Spanish or French) preferred
  • Python knowledge
  • Experience with external partnerships
  • Stakeholder engagement with internal teams and engineering roadmaps

What we offer you

Our compensation considers location, experience, and performance, with annual reviews and performance bonuses. Benefits include:

  • Distributed work environment with biannual in-person team sprints
  • USD 2,000 yearly learning and development budget
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards, holiday leave, parental leave, Employee Assistance Programme
  • Travel opportunities and upgrades for company events

About Canonical

Canonical pioneers in open source, publishing Ubuntu, a key platform for AI, IoT, and cloud. We hire globally, uphold high standards, and foster excellence. Since 2004, as a remote-first company, we challenge you to think differently, learn new skills, and innovate.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion, offering fair consideration regardless of background or identity.

Job Summary

Langan is seeking an entry-level Civil Engineer to join its collaborative team in Doylestown, PA. This individual will serve a key function in providing assistance with the planning, design, and permitting of civil engineering, land development, and infrastructure projects. In this role, you will have the opportunity to gain experience in site/civil engineering design for mixed-use developments, shopping centers, residential, higher education, federal, and other exciting land development projects.

  • Collaborate with team members on project tasks and assignments; and

Qualifications

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills;
  • Strong attention to detail with excellent analytical, multitasking, and judgment capabilities;
  • Ability to effectively work independently and in a team environment; and
  • Availability to work Monday through Friday with occasional evenings and weekends.

Langan provides a rich array of programs and benefits to help its employees advance their careers and enhance the quality of their lives. Our comprehensive compensation package includes: full-time employment company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage; life insurance, short- and long-term disability insurance, and paid pregnancy disability leave; 401(k)/Roth with company match; paid time off including parental and military leave; employee referral and professional license bonuses; and educational reimbursement.

Langan offers employee resource groups; flexible work schedules; extensive training; wellness programs; buddy and mentoring programs; and much more!

Langan is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. We believe that an inclusive workplace is essential for the well-being and success of our employees.

description:
No Grupo Rojemac , aqui, todas as pessoas são valorizadas e bem-vindas. O que realmente nos une é o compromisso com desafios, o espírito colaborativo e a paixão por viver nossa cultura. description:
Job Title: Store Manager

Req#: 00284939-304a-4252-b14a-b11c00ef2443

The Store Manager (SM) is responsible for managing all aspects of the business, with minimal direct supervision from the General Manager (GM), to ensure that Guests are delighted with a fast, friendly, fresh, clean, and in stock shopping experience, teaching and demonstrating core values, and supporting the GM in achieving store goals and initiatives. The SM assists the GM in maintaining a Staffed, Stable & Scheduled environment by providing a consistent Team Member experience through training, coaching, and recognition, while fostering a safety culture by Believing in Zero.

Essential Job Functions (Responsible to)

  1. Drive a safety culture by ensuring a clean, organized, and safe environment for all Team Members and Guests. Ensure proper procedure is followed relating to safety, accidents, and incidents including reporting, investigations, and documentation.
  2. Create a place of welcoming and belonging for our Guests and Team Members.
  3. Oversee the daily execution of the Store Operating System through management of the Game Plans to deliver a consistent Guest/brand experience that enables the store to achieve performance targets and improve financial performance; ability to delegate tasks accordingly and follow up to ensure completion.
  4. Engage and lead company initiatives.
  5. Oversee fresh food production to ensure food safety requirements are always met and par levels are maintained for a craveable and consistent offering, while growing sales and controlling waste.
  6. Develop well trained Team Members by following Thorntons’ training processes as prescribed while demonstrating and teaching our core values.
  7. Support and guide Team Members through career path while holding Team Members to a high standard of execution through coaching and accountability via Thorntons’ Progressive Discipline Process.
  8. Assist GM in facilitating the labor model by ensuring the team is working the schedule to our standard to maintain adequate coverage for all shifts.
  9. Train and empower Team Members to de-escalate Guest service issues.
  10. Communicate with Team Members in a positive manner that motivates and inspires them to act in accordance with Plan to Win strategy.
  11. Use a point-of-sale cash register and other electronic equipment.
  12. Comply with all federal, state, and local inspectors by taking immediate and appropriate action, and communicating and maintaining records of all inspections, certificates, and necessary records.
  13. Perform additional duties as assigned.

Key Relationships

  1. Region Manager
  2. General Manager
  3. Guest Service Representative
  4. Human Resource Manager
  5. Recruiter
  6. Trainer
  7. Auditor

Skills

  1. Demonstrates a commitment to leading by example, considering no tasks as below one’s position.
  2. Contributes to setting work priorities and direction, supporting the team in achieving goals and objectives.
  3. Demonstrates a positive and approachable presence, even during stressful situations.
  4. Recognizes positive performance, celebrates team achievements, and addresses poor performance.
  5. Provides feedback effectively and with empathy.
  6. Collaborates with GM to deliver high-quality Guest service.
  7. Fosters team camaraderie, collaboration, and cohesion.
  8. Proactively identifies potential issues and works with GM to take action to avoid workplace disruptions.
  9. Uses 'active listening' to understand viewpoints of others. Adjusts one's position/view to try and resolve conflict.
  10. Uses analytical skills to identify and solve a variety of business-related problems.
  11. Uses basic arithmetical skills to add, subtract and divide as necessary to complete financial reports, cash, inventory, etc.
  12. Values diversity and recognizes the strengths that individuals from divergent life experiences and backgrounds bring to the team.

Knowledge

  1. Principles and processes for providing Guest Service. This includes Guest needs assessment, meeting quality standards for services, and evaluation of Guest satisfaction.
  2. Principles and methods for displaying, promoting, and selling products or services.
  3. Principles and procedures for personnel recruitment, selection, and training.

Experience

Minimum one (1) year of management in retail and/or food and beverage industries.

Equipment/Special Expertise

NA

Required or Preferred Qualifications/Certifications

  1. High School Diploma or GED (required).
  2. Must have reliable transportation.
  3. Valid driver’s license (preferred).
  4. Food Safety and Handling Certifications (This is preferred. If not possessed upon hire, must have the ability to obtain one).

Physical Requirements

  1. Must be able to climb a ladder to clean windows, stock shelves, make price changes, etc.
  2. Daily Standing, Pushing, Pulling, Reaching, Bending, Squatting, Climbing, Walking and Lifting up to 50 lbs.
  3. Occasional Sitting and Driving required.
  4. Exposed to extreme weather conditions and temperatures.
  5. Long periods of standing.

We will rely on you for the following:

  • Provide troubleshooting and technical assistance for ProjectWise Product functionality/features to users via e-mail, service tickets, phone, and web-portal (BE Communities.

  • Work in a fast-paced environment while collaborating with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Act as a liaison between users and Product Management/Development.
  • Research and identify solutions to ProjectWise Product functionality/features.
  • Ask users targeted questions to quickly understand the root of the problem.
  • Maintain accurate notes and details on user support requests.
  • Properly escalate unresolved issues to appropriate internal teams (e.g., software developers).
  • Communicate with team members regarding current/ongoing issues via daily scrum calls.
  • Document software problem defects for review and take corrective actions.
  • Document technical knowledge in the form of Knowledgebase Articles or Communities Posts.
  • Meet with internal Bentley teams to provide the users’ perspective on our products and services.

Your daily tasks will look like this:

  • Review individual Support Case Backlog and prioritize Aged and Escalated Requests.
  • Reproduce issues in-house on test systems (Virtual Machines) to isolate the cause of the problem.
  • Monitor the Team Support Cases Queue and pick issues in the order of priority, impact, and age of the Service Request.
  • Update and follow-up with users over the phone/email on existing Requests.
  • Engage on Team Scrum calls to discuss issues and liaison with the team
  • Adhere to Phone Queue Schedule and ensure phones are always manned and voicemails processed.

  • Experience with the Administration of Engineering Information/Document Management systems.
  • Experience or knowledge with relational databases: Microsoft SQL Server or Oracle.
  • Experience or knowledge with Networking (DNS, TCP\IP, FQDN, cluster environments).
  • Experience or knowledge with Windows Operating System (Server and client) for administration and debugging.
  • A "user first" approach and strong critical thinking, with a desire to solve problems with excellent troubleshooting skills.
  • Emotional intelligence when talking with users, and the ability to document methodically.
  • Exposure to answering queries via Service Requests and Communities forum posts.
  • Ability to work well with Global colleagues to help address user issues.
  • Ability to manage time effectively by delegating, prioritizing, and scheduling tasks to ensure they are completed in the expected timelines.
  • A motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently and in a team.

What would make you stand out:

  • Experience with ProjectWise infrastructure.
  • Knowledge or experience of IIS (Internet Information Services),
  • Proven success in all aspects of ProjectWise Administration.
  • Experience with MicroStation, AutoCAD, Revit, Civil 3D, IPLOT (Printing\Plotting).
  • Knowledge with extended ProjectWise features (Publishing such as ICS for PDF, BAS; Bentley cloud features such as Deliverables Management, ProjectWise Drive, ProjectWise Projects, WSG, etc.)
  • An exciting career as an integral part of a world-leading software company providing solutions for architecture, engineering, and construction.

  1. Liderar a equipe de engenharia na elaboração de projetos para a construção de embarcações tipo PSV, OSRV e RSV;
  2. Garantir que todos os projetos sejam executados conforme o planejamento, dentro dos prazos e orçamento estabelecidos;
  3. Assegurar a qualidade dos projetos, seguindo as normas e regulamentos do setor naval;
  4. Coordenar com outras áreas da empresa para garantir a integração e eficiência dos projetos;

  6. Supervisionar a execução dos projetos, garantindo a conformidade com os requisitos técnicos e operacionais;
  7. Manter-se atualizado com as tendências e tecnologias do setor naval, aplicando melhores práticas nos projetos;
  8. Gerenciar a comunicação com stakeholders internos e externos, incluindo clientes, fornecedores e parceiros internacionais.

Requisitos necessários:

  1. Formação Superior completa em Engenharia;
  2. Sólida experiência profissional no setor naval;
  3. Desejável experiência em projetos internacionais no setor naval;
  4. Fortes habilidades de liderança e gestão de equipes;
  5. Alta capacidade de resolução de problemas complexos e tomada de decisões estratégicas;
  6. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação;
  7. Inglês fluente.

A Tenenge, marca pertencente a OEC, atua no segmento de Plantas Industriais de forma integrada, reunindo capacidade técnica, gerencial e financeira para executar o ciclo completo de empreendimentos de grande porte em regime de EPC e EPCM, em qualquer parte do mundo.

Com ampla experiência no desenvolvimento de projetos de Construção e Montagem, cuja complexidade demanda alta especialização para garantir previsibilidade, eficiência e segurança nos resultados, atua nos seguintes setores:

Termoeletricidade

A Enseada é um dos maiores investimentos privados da Bahia nos últimos anos, consolidando conhecimentos e expertise dos seus acionistas no segmento de construção naval e offshore. Com tecnologia Kawasaki Heavy Industries, a Enseada foi implantada estrategicamente às margens do Rio Paraguaçu, no Estado da Bahia. O estaleiro está localizado em águas abrigadas e com calado profundo, sem incidência de correnteza ou ventos inesperados, e sem concorrência de atracação com outras indústrias, promovendo geração de emprego e renda na região do recôncavo baiano, reconhecida como celeiro de grandes projetos offshore desde a década de 1980.

Sr. Cloud Application Architect, AWS Professional Services

Join to apply for the Sr. Cloud Application Architect, AWS Professional Services role at Amazon Web Services (AWS) .

Description

The AWS Professional Services (ProServe) organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings that help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, covering a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

The ProServe team is seeking a skilled Sr. Cloud Application Architect to join us at AWS. In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Sr. Cloud Application Architect, you will lead customer engagements, architecting and guiding enterprise application modernization and cloud development. You will work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As a trusted advisor, you will guide customers on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, ensuring best practices, performance optimization, and risk management throughout projects.

Key job responsibilities

  • Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
  • Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
  • Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
  • Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
  • Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

About The Team

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage you to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and continue to innovate — trusted by startups and Global 500 companies alike to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

At AWS, we foster a culture of learning and curiosity. Our employee-led affinity groups promote inclusion and diversity, supported by events and learning experiences like CORE and AmazeCon.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We are committed to professional development through mentorship, knowledge sharing, and career resources to help you grow.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony and offer flexibility to support your personal and professional life.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
  • 5+ years of experience designing and delivering enterprise solutions, including application modernization using Python, JavaScript, Node.js, Java, C#, Go, or Ruby on AWS
  • Proven technical leadership in complex projects
  • Knowledge of APIs, microservices, serverless architectures, containerization, and DevOps
  • Effective communication skills in English in technical and business contexts

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with SOA, ESB, and n-tier architectures
  • Ability to communicate effectively in Spanish in technical and business settings
  • AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect, Developer Associate)

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Flutter Pleno / Sênior
description:
Tecnologia é o que nos move e faz a empresa crescer de forma acelerada. Ela começa na base de tudo - nas motos, cada uma sai da nossa garagem equipada com um IoT para garantir segurança e suporte 24/7 para os entregadores, e nos ajudar a tomar melhores decisões de negócio.
Todos os nossos sistemas foram desenvolvidos dentro de casa, tanto os softwares utilizados internamente, para gestão da frota, manutenção e atendimento a clientes, quanto nosso app e plataforma de delivery.
Já nascemos uma empresa 100% cloud, com tecnologias e boas práticas do mercado.
Mas, como toda empresa tech, já estamos de olho na nossa próxima mudança e evolução, onde todos nossos sistemas vão para uma nova arquitetura de serviços, dando mais liberdade para as equipes explorarem novas tecnologias e linguagens de programação.
No dia a dia, você irá:

  • Projetar, desenvolver, testar e documentar aplicações móveis com Flutter;
  • Participar ativamente das discussões de escopo junto ao PM e contribuir na priorização das tarefas com foco total na experiência do cliente;
  • Investigar e solucionar problemas relacionados à escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e confiabilidade das aplicações;
  • Colaborar com o time utilizando ferramentas como Jira para gestão de tarefas e GitHub para versionamento de código
O que esperamos de você:
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Dart e no ecossistema Flutter;
  • Domínio em integrações com APIs RESTful;
  • Boa comunicação, colaboração e disposição para aprender e ensinar;
  • Proatividade para identificar e propor melhorias constantes;
  • Conhecimento de conceitos arquiteturais e boas práticas em aplicações móveis, especialmente com foco em arquitetura modular, iOS, Android e WEB.
Será um diferencial se você tiver:
  • Experiência com GetX para gerenciamento de estado e navegação;
  • Vivência com plataformas móveis nativas (Android/iOS);
  • Conhecimentos em Kotlin e Swift;
  • Familiaridade com funcionalidades core do Android, como localização, câmera, entre outras;
  • Experiência com outras tecnologias de desenvolvimento mobile, como React Native ou Xamarin;
  • Experiência com processos de CI/CD e automações de build e deploy para ambientes de teste e produção;
  • Conhecimento em NestJS e arquitetura BFF (Backend for Frontend).
SOBRE A MOTTU
Nós da Mottu acreditamos no poder de transformar vidas através da mobilidade e da inovação. Fundada em 2020, somos hoje a maior empresa de aluguel de motos do mundo, com mais de 100.000 motos em circulação e presença em mais de 100 filiais no Brasil e no México. Em setembro de 2023, concluímos nossa rodada Series C de US$ 50 milhões, liderada por grandes nomes do Venture Capital, como Crankstart Foundation, Bicycle Capital e QED Investors.
Somos a startup que mais cresce na América Latina e estamos no caminho para atingir o status de unicórnio ainda em 2025. Acreditamos em um mundo conectado e simplificado, com soluções tecnológicas que melhoram vidas. Valorizamos a superação, a igualdade e a união para construir juntos e transformar a forma como pensamos e agimos. Nós somos Mottu.
Nossos princípios inspiram cada passo da nossa trajetória e guiam nossas ações. Acreditamos no medo de ser mediano e, por isso, não nos conformamos com nada menos do que o excepcional: pensar grande e pensar pequeno dá o mesmo trabalho, então damos cada dia 10% a mais do que conseguimos dar no anterior, sempre buscando a grandeza e a escalabilidade. Nosso Foco no Cliente é inegociável, pois nascemos para dar oportunidade a quem nunca teve uma e somos obstinados em ajudá-los a conquistar seus sonhos. Mantemos a Cabeça de Dono, tomando decisões com coragem, autonomia e responsabilidade para deixar um legado com paixão e “sangue nos olhos”. Com Mão na Graxa, arregaçamos as mangas e fazemos nós mesmos para entender e melhorar cada processo, respeitando sempre a opinião de quem está na ponta da lança. E atuamos Ombro a Ombro, apoiando-nos mutuamente, cultivando relações genuínas, sinceras e duradouras, com a coragem de falar a verdade — afinal, aqui não há espaço para jogar em primeira pessoa.
Se você busca crescimento acelerado, desafios constantes e deseja fazer parte da nossa missão de revolucionar a mobilidade, a Mottu é o lugar certo para você! Venha somar ao time e construir conosco o futuro da mobilidade na América Latina.

description:

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The role of a Customer Success Manager at Canonical
Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective to reduce risk and churn, facilitate the adoption of new products or services and support expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. Through a clear understanding of their customer's objectives, the CSM can activate a large range of internal and external capabilities to alleviate any pain point, align expectations, as well as help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.
We are growing our Customer Success team to continue offering thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open source infrastructure and applications.
This role is a first step in the CSM organisation. Although you will primarily focus on the Tech segment, including the store customers, you will also have a portfolio assigned. Ubuntu is chosen by thousands of new users every month. Our responsibility is to ensure the best user experience for them through problem-solving, onboarding, enablement and value realisation all the way to success. Collaborating with other teams and participating in campaign efforts, you will connect with a diverse set of users of Canonical products and identify our future champions.
Location: This role will be based remotely worldwide.
What your day will look like

  • A strong focus on supporting customers by finding solutions to ticket requests.
  • Enrich documentation about problem solving, Q&A, onboarding materials.
  • Drive campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
  • Identify high potential as well as high risk customers from newly onboarded users or customers
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Engage with your portfolio of customers to ensure risk identification
  • Collect feedback from customers and format them for review by the product team
What we are looking for in you
  • Customer-facing experience
  • An empathetic individual with a natural drive to help others
  • Passion for technology, infrastructure and Ubuntu in particular is a must
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Strong organisational skills, ability to structure and constantly update documentation
  • A team player capable of interacting with all departments internally
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Em Vendas, estamos focados em alcançar desempenho superior em todos os nossos canais, operando em categorias altamente competitivas. Esse foco resulta em um ambiente dinmico e rápido, onde as equipes multifuncionais são incentivadas a colaborar para alcançar o sucesso.

Desenvolver comercialmente duas redes da região Sul com objetivo de atingir os planos e crescimentos definidos. Garantindo a execução da estratégia de nossas marcas, com foco em Sell out e presença.

• Acompanhar as alterações e lançamentos de novos produtos, visando atingir a distribuição e giro estabelecidos pela Cia.
• Monitorar de perto as tendências do mercado e dos concorrentes para identificar e capturar oportunidades de vendas;
• Construir relacionamento com as áreas de Trade, GC, Supply e E-commerce com o objetivo de integrar e promover novas soluções para o portfólio da Reckitt;
• Desenvolver o potencial dos clientes do território com harmonia comercial na região;
• Capacidade de construir uma venda persuasiva, relatórios de acompanhamento de negócio, assim como suportar o crescimento dos clientes;
• Back Office, controle de pagamentos, conta corrente, fechamento de ações, comprovações de verba e contratos.

• Superior Completo

Com a inclusão no centro de tudo o que fazemos, trabalhando em conjunto com os nossos Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), apoiamos os nossos colaboradores em cada etapa da sua jornada profissional, ajudando-os a ter sucesso à sua maneira individual.

TRACTIAN is transforming the industrial world by empowering frontline maintenance workers to achieve more. We’ve fused cutting-edge hardware with innovative software into one powerful platform, disrupting legacy systems and delivering smarter, faster solutions for our clients.

At TRACTIAN, you'll break boundaries, question convention, and collaborate with top talent to drive real change. As a part of our growth-stage startup, you’ll work alongside the founders, shaping the vision, products, and experiences that will define the future of industrial tech.

Hardware at TRACTIAN

The Hardware team is responsible for designing and improving our IoT devices, dealing with every step of the development process, ranging from PCB design, firmware programming, case design, validations and certifications, always aiming to build trustworthy products that can be produced at a mass scale.

What you'll do

As a Hardware Test Engineer for Electronics, you will be deeply involved in the electrical testing of hardware components and systems. Your expertise will be essential in executing a variety of electrical tests, from component-level analysis to system-wide functionality checks, ensuring all electronic products meet technical specifications and performance criteria.

Responsibilities

  • Design and conduct electrical tests such as signal integrity, power loading, and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) using oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, and network analyzers.
  • Implement embedded firmware for microcontrollers to simulate operational conditions for electronic testing.
  • Diagnose and troubleshoot circuitry issues using multimeters, logic analyzers, and in-circuit emulators.
  • Collaborate with design engineers to refine PCB layouts and circuit designs based on test findings.
  • Document all test results and develop reports that outline findings, conclusions, and recommendations for improvements.
  • Stay current with advancements in electronic testing equipment and techniques.
  • Adhere to and enforce compliance with electronic safety standards and regulations.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a closely related technical discipline.
  • 3+ years of experience with hands-on electronic hardware testing and debugging.
  • Strong proficiency with electronic test equipment and diagnostic tools.
  • Knowledge of printed circuit board (PCB) design and testing, including familiarity with EDA tools like KiCad or Altium Designer.
  • Solid understanding of digital and analog circuitry, as well as experience with power electronics.
  • Ability to read and interpret electronic schematics and datasheets.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with RF testing and wireless communications standards.
  • Involvement in open-source hardware projects or community electronics groups.
  • Fluent in English.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary and stock options
  • Optional fully funded English / Spanish courses
  • 30 days of paid annual leave

  • Earn a trip anywhere in the world every 4 years

1 day ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Critical Care - Intensivist Nurse Practitioner Job with St. Luke's University Health Network in PA role at PracticeLink

St. Luke's is proud of the skills, experience and compassion of its employees. The employees of St. Luke's are our most valuable asset! Individually and together, our employees are dedicated to satisfying the mission of our organization which is an unwavering commitment to excellence as we care for the sick and injured; educate physicians, nurses and other health care providers; and improve access to care in the communities we serve, regardless of a patient's ability to pay for health care.
The Advanced Practitioner is responsible for providing healthcare services to patients under the supervision of, and/or in collaboration with, the attending physician. In addition, the AP will participate in patient satisfaction, quality, and performance improvement initiatives.
CRITICAL CARE ADVANCED PRACTITIONERS AT ST. LUKE'S:
As our health network expands, our CCAP team continues to grow creating multifaceted opportunities within our department and the Network. We have 8 Campuses that provide Critical Care Services to our communities and allow for a diverse Critical Care Population and endless growth opportunities. As a member of the Critical Care Team, you are highly respected, and vital to St. Luke’s mission of providing affordable, high-quality care. As an Advanced Practitioner Provider, you will have the opportunity to practice medicine to your fullest potential in a multidisciplinary, collaborative model with excellent team dynamics.

  • Works in conjunction with critical care physicians and staff to care for medical, surgical and critical care patients as requested.
  • Performs therapeutic and diagnostic procedures as directed by the supervising physician. (See credentials list).
  • Participates in performance improvement activities, meetings, educational projects, and research projects while supporting the philosophy and strategic plan of the department.
  • Demonstrates ability to develop effective working relationships within the hospital and St. Luke's University Health Network.
  • Demonstrates competency in the assessment, range of treatment, knowledge of growth and development and communication appropriate to the age of the patient treated.
CRITICAL CARE UNITS:
  • Allentown Campus- 15 bed mixed Medical/Surgical ICU
  • Anderson Campus-16 bed mixed Medical/Surgical/Trauma ICU
  • Bethlehem Campus (Providers rotate through all ICU’s - Cardiac Medical/Surgical ICU 12 bed; Neuro ICU variable bed; Surgical/Trauma ICU variable beds)
  • Carbon Campus- 12 bed mixed Medical/Surgical ICU
  • GSL Campus-10 bed mixed Medical/Surgical ICU
  • Monroe Campus-12 bed mixed Medical/Surgical ICU
  • Upper Bucks Campus-10 bed mixed Medical/Surgical ICU
  • Warren Campus-12 bed mixed Medical/Surgical ICU
SCHEDULE:
  • Rotational Schedule days/nights/weekends to provide 24/7 Critical Care APP Coverage.
  • Night/Night Weekend ONLY positions available
  • 13 hour shifts (6a-7p and 6p-7a)
  • 18 shifts in a 6-week block.
  • No more than 50% nights and 50% weekends
JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Competent in the assessment, treatment, counseling, and education of the patient, and their families, being provided medical services.
  • Competency in evaluating patients and performing physical examinations including obtaining, studying, and updating medical histories.
  • Demonstrates ability to determine abnormal conditions by administering or ordering diagnostic tests, such as radiologic and laboratory studies, and then accurately interpreting test results.
  • Evaluates, develops, and implements appropriate patient management and treatment plans, based on assessment of needs
  • Coordinates and communicates patient care effectively with other healthcare professionals and institutions to meet patient’s healthcare needs.
  • Provides high quality health care, based on best practice and/or evidenced based medicine.
  • Performs therapeutic and diagnostic procedures, as appropriate, and aligned with granted clinical privileges
  • As requested, conduct virtual care services, described as live and interactive clinical assessments, diagnosis, and treatment of patients via St. Luke’s virtual care platform, assisting in care coordination and/or escalation of care, as appropriate
  • Maintains professional and technical knowledge by attending educational workshops, reviewing professional publications, establishing personal networks, and participating in professional societies. Maintains required continuing medical education
  • Participates in the research, development, implementation, and tracking of clinical management guidelines.
  • Participates in the teaching of multidisciplinary students (nursing, nurse practitioner, pharmacy, physician assistant, medical, etc.) and physician residents & fellows, ensuring a positive educational environment.
  • Participates in AP student clinical rotation preceptorship, when assigned
  • Demonstrates performance improvement in the following areas as appropriate: clinical care/outcomes, customer/service improvement, operational system/process, and safety.
  • Competent in utilizing electronic medical record, remains current with medical record documentation, and provides documentation that is for optimal for billing provided professional services.
  • Demonstrates financial responsibility and accountability through the effective and efficient use of resources in daily procedures, processes and practices.
  • Develops care and dispositions plans in conjunction with the case management team.
QUALIFICATIONS:
  • Must be board eligible or board-Certified Registered Nurse Practitioner with current license to practice in the state of Pennsylvania or New Jersey, as determined by the job location.
  • Two years of experience desired, preferably in critical care, trauma, and/or acute care setting. New grads are encouraged to apply!
WHAT CAN WE OFFER TO YOU?:
  • Robust orientation program for all levels of experience including new grads
  • Comprehensive Benefits Package
  • Competitive Compensation Package
  • CME plus Certification Cost Reimbursement
  • Fitness and Sports Performance Center Memberships
  • Malpractice Insurance
  • Team-based care with well-educated, dedicated support staff
  • Teaching, research, quality improvement and strategic development opportunities
CULTURE:
St. Luke’s is a thriving, integrated health network where more than 700 Advanced Practitioners are integral members of the health care team. Our employed providers benefit from a dedicated leadership structure, a professional organization, and a culture that puts patient care at the center. With an established department of advanced practice that has a dedicated leadership structure, and with room for advancement and growth within the Network.
Please complete your application using your full legal name and current home address. Be sure to include employment history for the past seven (7) years, including your present employer. Additionally, you are encouraged to upload a current resume, including all work history, education, and/or certifications and licenses, if applicable. It is highly recommended that you create a profile at the conclusion of submitting your first application. Thank you for your interest in St. Luke's!!

Fundada em Vitória (ES), a empresa já conta com mais de 35 milhões de clientes ativos e faz parte do grupo J&F, um dos maiores conglomerados empresariais do Brasil. Pautados pela nossa cultura, seguimos no propósito de dar muito mais pique para a vida de milhões de brasileiros. Conheça nossos valores: Atitude de Dono(a), Disciplina, Determinação, Disponibilidade, Simplicidade, Humildade e Franqueza.

title: Strategy & Consulting Partner
description:
Cache Ventures is dedicated to building, advising, and investing in high-growth companies across multiple industries. Our mission is to create and scale businesses that drive impact, innovation, and long-term value. Our growth strategy is powered by a combination of proprietary scaling frameworks, operational excellence, and an unwavering commitment to success.
We've helped countless startups accelerate growth, refine their business strategies, and scale to new heights. Now, we're expanding our efforts by bringing in top-tier talent to lead and execute our strategic consulting initiatives.
The Role
The Strategy & Consulting Partner will be a pivotal player in scaling our consulting frameworks and advisory services. This role is designed for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, possesses deep business acumen, and enjoys guiding companies through complex challenges. Specifically, this role will involve:

  • Presenting strategic business frameworks to portfolio companies and external clients

Why This Role Matters
This role offers a unique opportunity to work directly with ambitious entrepreneurs, high-growth startups, and emerging businesses. As part of Cache Ventures, you'll play a critical role in shaping the future of companies poised for major expansion.
By joining our team, you'll:

Internal

  • Develop performance tracking mechanisms to measure the effectiveness of strategic engagements

Results & Impact
  • Deliver high-impact workshops and consulting sessions with actionable takeaways

  • Build and lead a scalable consulting infrastructure that supports Cache Ventures' long-term vision

Requirements

  • Startup Agility: You thrive in fast-paced, startup-like environments where adaptability and quick decision making are essential
  • Exceptional Communication: You captivate audiences, command rooms with confidence, and know how to engage business owners through powerful storytelling and compelling insights
  • Master Influencer: You're skilled at navigating objections, winning buy-in, and inspiring action, turning skeptics into believers

At Cache Ventures, we believe in empowering leaders, driving strategic excellence, and making a tangible impact on the companies we work with. description:
Sobre o Stark Bank

No Stark Bank, somos mais que um banco digital para empresas: somos parceiros estratégicos que, desde 2018, vêm redefinindo o futuro dos serviços financeiros corporativos no Brasil. Oferecemos uma gama completa de serviços, desde o processamento ágil de pagamentos e faturas até a gestão inteligente de contas a receber, tudo integrado e automatizado através de uma API robusta e inovadora. Não nos contentamos em apenas otimizar processos; ambicionamos nos tornar o maior banco em tecnologia financeira, capacitando negócios a prosperarem com soluções que eliminam burocracias e impulsionam a eficiência.

Acreditamos que a chave para revolucionar o sistema financeiro reside na nossa busca incessante por inovação e na nossa capacidade de transformar problemas complexos em soluções impactantes. Cada linha de código, cada nova funcionalidade que desenvolvemos, é destinada a permitir que as empresas foquem no que realmente importa: estratégia e crescimento.

Nosso legado é ambicioso: construir o melhor ecossistema bancário em tecnologia e atendimento para empresas no Brasil. E para alcançar essa visão, precisamos de mentes curiosas, persistentes e apaixonadas por desafios. Se você se identifica com a minuciosidade, consistência e persistência que nos movem, se acredita na melhoria constante e coloca o cliente no centro de suas ações, e se busca um ambiente colaborativo e desafiador onde a ambição encontra a oportunidade de escalar, o Stark Bank é o seu lugar.

O desafio:

Responsável por auxiliar na implementação e manutenção do programa de Compliance, com foco específico na Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro (PLD) e no monitoramento de transações em nossa instituição de pagamentos. Irá atuar na análise de alertas, investigação de atividades suspeitas, desenvolvimento e aplicação de políticas e procedimentos, garantindo a conformidade com as regulamentações vigentes e contribuindo para a proteção da empresa contra riscos de LD/FT.


Você irá:
  • Monitoramento e Análise de Transações: Realizar o monitoramento de transações para identificar atividades suspeitas, analisando alertas e investigando casos potenciais de LD/FT.
  • Conformidade Regulatória e Políticas: Auxiliar na implementação e atualização de políticas e procedimentos de PLD/FT, garantindo o alinhamento com as regulamentações e normas internas.
  • Análise de Due Diligence e KYC: Apoiar a execução de processos de Conheça seu Cliente (KYC) e Due Diligence, avaliando o risco de clientes e transações.
  • Suporte à Avaliação de Riscos: Contribuir para a identificação, avaliação e mitigação dos riscos de LD/FT da instituição.
  • Elaboração de Relatórios e Documentação: Preparar relatórios de análises e investigações, além de auxiliar na documentação dos processos de PLD/FT.
  • Participação em Treinamentos e Projetos: Colaborar em treinamentos sobre PLD/FT e participar de projetos de melhoria contínua na área de Compliance.
O que nao pode faltar:
  • Experiência prévia (mínimo de 5 anos) na área de Compliance, com foco em Prevenção à Lavagem de Dinheiro e monitoramento de transações, preferencialmente em instituições financeiras ou de pagamentos.
  • Sólido conhecimento da legislação e regulamentação de PLD/FT no Brasil (Lei nº 9.613/1998 , regulamentação do Banco Central, COAF, etc.).
  • Experiência com sistemas e ferramentas de monitoramento de transações.
  • Capacidade analítica e crítica para interpretar dados e identificar padrões suspeitos.
  • Habilidade de comunicação oral e escrita para elaboração de relatórios e interação com diferentes áreas.
O que aumenta suas chances:
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados e ferramentas de BI.
  • Certificações na área de Compliance ou PLD.
  • Proficiência em inglês.

O que Oferecemos:

Oportunidade de trabalhar em uma empresa dinâmica e em crescimento no setor de pagamentos.

Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e desafiador.

Possibilidade de desenvolvimento profissional.

Pacote de remuneração e benefícios competitivo com o mercado.

O Que Oferecemos:

No Stark Bank, investimos no seu sucesso e acreditamos em um ambiente de trabalho onde você pode prosperar. Além de um ambiente desafiador e inovador, oferecemos:

Salário mensal atrativo comparado ao mercado.

Bônus anual, reconhecendo suas conquistas e o seu impacto.

Auxílio moradia (conforme política de distância do escritório).

Creditas para te ajudar a alcançar seus objetivos financeiros.

Curso de Inglês in-company para impulsionar seu desenvolvimento profissional.

Assistência médica e odontológica SulAmerica.

Gympass para cuidar da sua saúde física.

Seguro de vida para sua tranquilidade e da sua família.

Convênio com o SESC para acesso a diversas atividades culturais e de lazer.

Cartão Stark para Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação, oferecendo flexibilidade no seu dia a dia.

Vale transporte ou vaga de estacionamento para facilitar seu deslocamento.

Voucher Uber para idas e vindas em situações específicas.

Modelo de Trabalho:

Atuamos no modelo 100% presencial e você fará parte do nosso time incrível no coração de São Paulo: Rua Pamplona, 145 - Cerqueira César, São Paulo - SP.

Se você se identifica com o nosso propósito e acredita que pode fazer a diferença no futuro dos serviços financeiros para empresas, candidate-se!

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gerenciar o portfólio de aplicações SAP (ERP, IBP, APO) e tecnologias focadas na cadeia de valor e processos planejamento de demanda, planejamento de produção, otimização de inventário, assegurando performance, confiabilidade e estabilidade em um ambiente global;
  • Promover a arquitetura técnica definida e a observância aos processos internos de TI;
  • Liderar e participar de projetos / iniciativas digitais com foco em aplicações e soluções dos processos de Supply Chain e interfaces com processos comerciais e industriais;
  • Gerenciar orçamento e contrato de projetos e iniciativas, garantindo a otimização de custos e alinhamento estratégico;
  • Realizar as conexões necessárias entre os times de tecnologia e negócio para garantir o bom andamento do projeto e a cobertura end to end dos processos de Supply Chain;
  • Apoiar o negócio na definição dos requerimentos das soluções para atingir as metas de produtividade e inovação;
  • Monitorar tendências de tecnológicas em Supply Chain e TI, trazendo insights inovadores para fortalecer a estratégia digital;

  • Auxiliar usuários sobre os processos de desenvolvimento, manutenção e/ou contratação de novo serviço de software, incluindo novos módulos SAP ERP, SAP IBP, SAP APO.

Requisitos:

  • Fluência em inglês para comunicação com equipes globais.

Nível: Especialista

Cursos de: Engenharia de Produção, Marketing, Administração de Empresas, Comunicação Social

Responsabilidades da Posição

  • Definir estratégias de relacionamento com o cliente ao longo da jornada, atraindo novos clientes, promovendo engajamento, retenção e crescimento de receita usando ferramentas de CRM, automações e campanhas segmentadas.
  • Construir jornadas personalizadas e estratégias de fidelização, através da análise de dados de clientes para identificar padrões, tendências e insights relevantes.
  • Gerenciar a base de dados de clientes, garantindo sua qualidade, segmentação e insights acionáveis, planejando e executando campanhas de CRM focadas em aquisição, ativação, retenção e reativação.
  • Criar segmentos de clientes com base em dados demográficos, comportamentais e de compra, para personalizar campanhas e comunicações.
  • Desenvolver, implementar e otimizar fluxos de comunicação e campanhas automatizadas (e-mail, SMS, push, WhatsApp, entre outros), criando conteúdo personalizado e relevante para cada segmento.
  • Realizar testes A/B, análises de performance e gerar relatórios para melhorias contínuas.
  • Administrar ferramentas de CRM e automação, como RD Station, HubSpot, Salesforce, Dynamics, entre outras.
  • Estabelecer KPIs para medir o sucesso das ações de CRM, como taxa de abertura, clique, conversão, retenção e valor vitalício, propondo ações de otimização e apresentando relatórios e insights.
  • Avaliar o ROI das campanhas de CRM, otimizando orçamento e recursos.
  • Colaborar com equipes de Comunicação, Trade, Comercial e Tecnologia para alinhar estratégias e garantir consistência nas ações.
  • Revisar processos e rotinas existentes, garantindo eficiência operacional, minimizando erros, maximizando produtividade e escalabilidade.

Requisitos obrigatórios para a posição

  • Superior completo.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência na área.
  • Domínio de estratégias, execução de CRM, automação de marketing e construção de jornadas de clientes personalizadas.
  • Habilidade com segmentação de base de dados e análise de métricas de campanha.
  • Visão estratégica, perfil analítico, proatividade e orientação a resultados.

Sobre a empresa

Somos a Drogaria Venancio, uma marca carioca com mais de 45 anos, que coloca o cuidado no centro de tudo. Com mais de 135 lojas físicas e mais de 4.900 colaboradores, estamos presentes em diversos bairros do Rio de Janeiro e municípios como Niterói, São Gonçalo, Duque de Caxias, Angra dos Reis, Nova Iguaçu, São João de Meriti, Petrópolis, Teresópolis, Búzios e Volta Redonda. Além disso, nossos canais digitais atuam em mais de 10 estados, levando saúde, beleza e bem-estar a milhares de clientes em todo o Brasil.

Nosso propósito? Cuidar das pessoas de forma acessível, humanizada e inovadora. Saúde vai além de medicamentos: é qualidade de vida, prevenção e bem-estar.

Fundada em 2014, a Hospinova é uma empresa do Grupo Venancio focada no mercado hospitalar e distribuição farmacêutica, garantindo serviço especializado e eficiente. Contamos com três centros de distribuição no Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo e Belo Horizonte.

Nos destacamos pelo nosso espírito carioca, acolhimento, inovação, valorização do capital humano, ética, transparência e simplicidade. Cada cliente é prioridade e cada detalhe importa.

Até 2025, planejamos inaugurar mais 23 lojas e expandir nossa presença, sempre oferecendo atendimento de excelência e soluções completas para o bem-estar de nossos clientes.

Se você compartilha nossa paixão por cuidar de pessoas, venha crescer conosco!

Como Mandrilhador I, você será responsável por:

TAREFAS DIÁRIAS

  • Realizar reunião de pré-trabalho, preenchendo formulário e check list, fazendo a leitura dos procedimentos e documentos para realização da operação, com o objetivo de identificar se os itens necessários para a execução da atividade estão disponíveis.
  • Realizar movimentação de peça para a máquina, utilizando ponte rolante, talha, cintas, olhais, correntes e manilhas, seguindo os procedimentos de segurança e isolando a área.
  • Preparar peça na máquina - fixar a peça na mesa da mandrilhadora de acordo com as informações fornecidas pela Engenharia Industrial (Doc.: folha de preparação), garantindo que a peça não se mova durante a operação de usinagem.
  • Realizar o isolamento da área, seguindo os procedimentos de segurança.
  • Realizar captura dos pontos zeros inserindo a captura dos pontos zeros conforme informado pela Engenharia industrial, utilizando relógios apalpadores, comparadores ou cabeça Probe. Essa atividade é feita para garantir que as coordenadas do programa CNC estejam de acordo com o posicionamento geométrico da peça.
  • Realizar zeramento de ferramentas - encostar a ferramenta na peça ou com bloco padrão entre a peça e a ferramenta para realizar o zeramento. Inserir os valores na máquina de forma manual com o objetivo de determinar o ponto de início (ponto zero) da ferramenta com relação a peça, para realizar a usinagem.
  • Realizar operação de usinagem em mandrilhadoras Wotans - a usinagem das peças é feita conforme sequência pré-definida no programa CNC. Serão realizadas operações de fresamento, furação, rosqueamento e usinagem de perfis internos com ferramentas especiais, transformando a matéria prima nas dimensões especificadas no projeto do cliente.
  • Realizar inspeções das medidas usinadas fazendo uso de instrumentos de medição como: paquímetro, micrômetro, súbito, tubular, ball-gage, relógios entre outros, assegurando que não sejam fabricadas peças com dimensões que estejam fora da especificação no projeto do cliente.
  • Realizar usinagem utilizando cabeçotes angulares - deve-se fixar cabeçote angular na máquina, inclinando de acordo com as determinações da Engenharia Industrial, para realizar operações em ângulos, graus, em diâmetros internos de difícil acesso.

Para ter sucesso nessa função, você precisa:

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Curso de Fresador CNC
  • Experiência prévia na função
  • Controle dimensional
  • Leitura e interpretação de desenho técnicos
  • Conhecimentos de Métodos e Processos de Usinagem
  • Identificar e registrar findings de segurança
  • Identificar e sugerir melhorias do processo
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos
  • Conhecimentos em Tolerâncias Geométricas (GD&T)

  • Manuseio e transporte de peças com ponte rolante
  • Conhecimentos básicos nos softwares: Oracle, Epims, Gensuite, Manusis
  • Conhecimento em ferramental e consumíveis para os processos produtivos existentes
  • Treinamento LEAN Básico

title: Senior DevOps Engineer FTE PT
description:
Welcome to Islands, where innovation meets execution, and bold ideas are turned into world-class products. We’re not your typical tech company—we’re a Product and Venture Studio that works with startups, scale-ups, and also seeds our own SaaS ventures. In just 18 months, we’ve scaled rapidly, building revolutionary software that solves real-world problems across industries. Our global team of 35+ brilliant minds spans Canada and Brazil, and we’re expanding fast. We’re looking for someone like you to help lead the charge.

Our culture is simple:

  • Break the rules — be bold, experiment, and push beyond expectations.
  • Embrace imperfection — progress trumps perfection in everything we do.
  • Have fun along the way — whether it's product sprints or team retreats in exotic locations like Bali or Florianopolis.

Position Overview

As a Senior DevOps Engineer, you’ll be at the heart of Islands’ technical innovation, architecting and refining cloud infrastructure to support our groundbreaking products—both client-facing and internal. You’ll design and scale microservice-based architectures, work hands-on with AWS, and ensure our CI/CD pipelines are robust. This role is flexible, suitable for full-time or part-time candidates.

We’re offering an opportunity to redefine how the future works, collaborating with a team that embraces experimentation and innovation at every turn.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement scalable, highly-available cloud infrastructure using AWS and microservices architecture.
  • Collaborate with developers to manage cloud resources for core projects, including Frameflow, our AI-powered QA Engineer.
  • Lead CI/CD pipeline development, ensuring seamless continuous deployment.
  • Oversee infrastructure-as-code practices using Terraform and modern tools.
  • Optimize for performance, security, and scalability as products expand into new markets.
  • Experiment with the latest DevOps technologies to continually improve infrastructure.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of DevOps experience with hands-on cloud architecture in AWS.
  • Proficiency with microservices, containerization tools like Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Expertise with CI/CD pipelines and automation, including scalable IaaC with Terraform or similar.
  • Experience with version control (Git, Mercurial, SVN), reverse proxies, gRPC, K8s, Github Actions.
  • Familiarity with our tech stack and experience as a developer in React, Node.js, Typescript, or Python for Machine Learning.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and an innovative mindset.
  • Experience with AWS and GCP.

Why Islands?

  • Unlimited vacation — work-life balance is essential for creativity and growth.
  • Micro-promotions — continuous growth through small, frequent promotions.
  • Annual retreats to Bali, Florianopolis, and other island locations.
  • Cutting-edge projects — working on products pushing the boundaries of software development and AI.
  • Culture of innovation — we break things fast, fix them faster, and love to experiment. We work hard and have fun.

If you’re ready to join a team building the future of tech and reshaping industries with AI-powered QA solutions, we’d love to meet you.

title: Analista Comercial - E-commerce
description:
Somos o Grupo Webcontinental, a Sua Melhor Escolha!

A Webcontinental foi fundada em 2007 com o objetivo de transformar a vida das pessoas. O Grupo atua como e-commerce, marketplace, e possui a sua indústria própria através de duas verticais - Gallant Importação e Gallant Indústria.

Ao longo dos 16 anos de atuação no mercado, a Webcontinental ampliou suas áreas de atuação para diferentes segmentos, e conta com uma moderna estrutura física e uma logística eficiente, permitindo sua atuação em todo o território nacional.

A sede administrativa está localizada em Porto Alegre - RS, além dos três centros de distribuição (Viana - ES, Cariacica - ES e Navegantes - SC), e um escritório em São Paulo.

COMPROMISSO E CERTIFICAÇÃO:

A Webcontinental possui diversas certificações fundamentais para a construção de credibilidade no e-commerce, como o selo Ebit, que reafirma o compromisso ético da empresa em levar segurança ao processo de compra.

Além disso, algumas premiações coroaram a Web como empresa consolidada no meio, como o Prêmio ABComm de Inovação Digital 2024, que pela segunda vez consecutiva elegeu a Webcontinental como Melhor Marketplace do Brasil.

São 4 mil sellers cadastrados na Webcontinental Marketplace, que contam com um catálogo de 40 categorias, totalizando mais de 4 milhões de produtos cadastrados, vendidos através do site e de aplicativo próprio.

A missão da Webcontinental é proporcionar aos clientes um serviço de qualidade e agilidade, simplificando suas vidas.

Descrição da Vaga: Analista Comercial de Categoria

Como Analista Comercial de Categoria, você fará parte do time com um profundo conhecimento do mercado e das dinâmicas do setor e, principalmente, das categorias em que atua. Este profissional será responsável por:

  1. Analisar dados de venda do mercado e do nosso canal.
  2. Planejar e executar estratégias para potencializar e desenvolver os resultados por categoria dentro do site, garantindo o atingimento de metas de GMV e margem estabelecidas pela gestão.
  3. Atuar estrategicamente na negociação direta com os Sellers parceiros, elaborando campanhas comerciais e controlando a precificação.
  4. Selecionar e gerenciar os produtos das suas respectivas categorias que serão destacados em nosso site.
  5. Criar a curva ABC das categorias, identificando potenciais e oportunidades.
  6. Negociar Mix de produtos por categoria com a equipe interna de sellers, buscando melhor competitividade e rentabilidade para o e-commerce.
  7. Realizar análise e pesquisa de mercado diária para identificação de oportunidades e otimização necessária nas ações em andamento.
  8. Monitorar preço, estoque, frete e prazos de entrega para os produtos potenciais das categorias.
  9. Preencher diariamente planilhas de resultados, apontando desvios e atuando em planos de ação.
  10. Colaborar com o time de e-commerce na execução de campanhas de marketing promocional do site.
  11. Trabalhar as metas de venda válida e margem/comissão por categoria, estabelecidas pela equipe de gestão.
  12. Desenvolver estratégias e ações para alcançar as metas estabelecidas por categoria e canal como um todo.
  13. Preparar e apresentar relatórios e análises de resultados da categoria.
  14. Atuar junto ao time de televendas na elaboração e aprovação de orçamentos.
  15. Garantir exposição no site para os produtos com melhor competitividade e potencial de resultado da categoria.

Product Development and Operations / Full time / Hybrid

Guidewire is looking for a proactive and solution-driven Cloud Platform Support Database Engineer to join our dynamic Global Support team. The Engineer will work collaboratively within the Product Development Operations (PDO) team, serving our customers in both Guidewire Cloud and on-premise environments. This role requires a keen understanding of our platform, backed by the continuous learning provided by Guidewire Education, Product Development, and Site Reliability Engineering teams. You will be learning new and exciting AWS technologies as we continue our journey on the cloud. In addition, you will work on multiple database platforms and utilize your skills in performance tuning, and troubleshooting. The successful candidate will be part of the Product Development Operations (PDO) organization working in a hybrid environment that delivers 24x7 service to customers who are using our software on the Guidewire Cloud Platform.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  1. Function as a primary contact to review, investigate, and promptly fulfill Customer requests and resolve incidents in adherence to team standards, thereby ensuring we meet and exceed customer satisfaction.
  2. Provide support for the Oracle, Microsoft SQL Server and Aurora (MySQL/PostgreSQL) production and non-production databases.
  3. Document and maintain technical articles, including troubleshooting guides, knowledge base articles, and runbooks, in order to meet objectives for customer request fulfillment and issue resolution.
  4. Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of our database, platform and applications through company-sponsored training and experience.
  5. Job activities include setup (provisioning), configuration, monitoring and production support of platform and database environments on EC2 and RDS/Aurora platforms.
  6. Collaborate with the development and support teams, develop and foster strong relationships with customers and stakeholders, and act as a trusted advisor and technical point of contact.
  7. Strong eye for product and process improvements, collaborating with other departments within the company, following the escalation path if needed.
  8. Contribute to an environment that encourages information sharing, team-based mindset, cross-training, and an absolute focus on doing what is best for the customer.

Required skills and experience:

  1. Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science (or a related STEM field), or related experience.
  2. 3+ years of experience working with and troubleshooting Oracle, MySQL, MSSQL or other database technologies. Experience with AWS RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL is a plus.
  3. Working knowledge of one or more database high availability technologies and database data replication tools is an advantage.
  4. Unix/Linux general administration skills and/or python/powershell scripting is a distinct advantage.
  5. Experience in working with AWS services, such as EC2, S3, RDS, and (Kubernetes) ECS/EKS, to deploy and manage Java applications in a cloud environment is a plus.
  6. Experience solving issues with software code and reporting progress; preference for experience with a commercial customer incident tracking tool or CRM like Salesforce.
  7. Experience using a software defect tracking system such as JIRA preferred.
  8. Skills to read and interpret application server log files.
  9. 3+ years’ experience working directly with customers or key internal partners; preference for support for a B2B software company.
  10. Outstanding analytical and troubleshooting skills; with great attention to detail, ability to think critically and display an aptitude for problem-solving.
  11. We provide 24x7 support and the job may require working shifts outside of normal business hours and weekend shifts.
  12. Read, write, and speak fluent English. Score bonus points if you have skills in another language such as French or Spanish.

Personal Qualities and Soft skills

  1. You enjoy teaching and being a mentor to others.
  2. Good communication and presentation skills with an ability to explain complex technical concepts to a varied audience.
  3. Display a strong work ethic and do whatever it takes to get the job done.
  4. A highly positive can-do attitude, thrives in a team-oriented environment, values diversity, and actively contributes to team goals.
  5. Demonstrates strong follow-through and consistently keep commitments to customers and employees.
  6. Self motivated, and ability to manage multiple tasks with different deadlines.

Bonus

  1. Company pension contributions.
  2. Fully funded medical insurance for you and your family.
  3. Annual Wellness Reimbursement.
  4. 26 annual leave days.
  5. 16 weeks paid maternity and paternity leave.
  6. 3 paid days volunteering in the community.

title: GeoTechnical Engineer - Senior Level
description:
Moffatt & Nichol specializes in large complex waterfront infrastructure projects and is recognized as one of the worldwide leaders in this field. We are actively looking for a Geotechnical Engineer to join our Sao Paulo office. As part of the Geotechnical Group, the Geotechnical Engineer assesses and analyzes the ground on which wharves, quays, buildings and other structures will be constructed/operated; examine the soil, checks the flow of underground water, and conducts other tests to ensure the stability of an area before construction begins. Development of structural/ geotechnical projects of foundations and retaining structures.

About Moffatt & Nichol:

Moffatt & Nichol is a leading U.S.-based global infrastructure advisor specialising in the planning and design of facilities that shape and serve our coastlines, harbours, and rivers. Reflecting Moffatt & Nichol’s commitment to design innovation since 1945, Engineering News-Record (ENR) has ranked the company No. 1 in Marine and Port Facilities and among the Top 50 Designers in International Markets.

Moffatt & Nichol's professional staff includes engineers, planners, scientists, and architects who serve our global client base from offices in Europe, the Americas, and the Pacific Rim. The firm provides clients worldwide with customised service and a level of excellence that have become the firm’s hallmark in three primary practise areas—coastal, environmental, and water resources; ports and harbours; and transportation, bridges, and rail.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Prepare specifications, interpret field test data (SPT, sCPT, FVST, DMT) and estimate soil engineering properties for foundation design and soil-structure interaction (SSI)
  • Recommend and monitor lab tests on items in a laboratory. Interpret results, analyze soil properties, note any contamination or other issues, and produce reports about their findings for project managers
  • Perform construction site inspections and prepare inspection reports
  • Perform geostructural analysis and design of waterfront structures, including bulkheads, retaining walls, deep foundations, and flood control structures
  • Design wall structural components, including wales, tie rods, tiebacks, cap beams, etc., comprising local and global soil stability
  • Design of buried structures
  • Design and preparation of construction drawings and contract documents
  • Study safety quality standards for different projects and ensure that each project adheres to these standards. Inspects foundations, observing drilling activities, and reviewing work plans as some ways geotechnical engineers ensure adherence to these standards
  • Present possible project risks, evaluate seismic activities geotechnical effects, make recommendations for foundations and excavation activities, and summarize the progress of individual projects
  • Resolve design problems that may include performing field investigation or inspections, detailed design work, and detailed checking of design computations done by others, or general coordination of specific design aspects into a project
  • Manage and lead multidisciplinary projects, coordinating local and international professionals and subcontractors
  • Manage internal and external client's needs and expectations
  • Perform quality assurance reviews and adhere to Moffatt & Nichol Quality Management System
  • Lead, mentor, and assist engineers and designers in developing final design plans
  • Perform office-based construction administration including review of shop drawings and technical submittals
  • Preparation of techno-commercial proposals for the services offered by Moffatt & Nichol

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or relevant experience
  • M.Sc. degree in geotechnical engineering
  • Fluency in English (Essential)
  • 15+ years of experience
  • Professional Engineer licensure in Brazil CREA
  • Experience and proficiency with the following or equivalent geotechnical software package categories:
  • Lateral pile analysis (i.e., LPile, AllPile)
  • Axial pile/drilled shaft analysis (i.e., APile, AllPile, Driven, Shaft)
  • Pile group analysis (i.e., Group, AllPile)
  • Slope stability (i.e., Slope, Slide)
  • Excavation support (i.e., DeepEX, WALLAP, Support-IT, CT Shoring Suite)
  • Finite element analysis (i.e., Plaxis)

We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

Lenovo is a US$57 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #248 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit , and read about the latest news via our StoryHub .

Description and Requirements

Lenovo is launching a new Infrastructure Solutions Group (ISG) digital business in Brazil, focused on driving direct sales of server, storage, and infrastructure products through Lenovo.com.br. As the ISG Brazil eCommerce Program Manager , you will lead the end-to-end go-to-market strategy and business operations for this critical initiative, with a strong focus on accelerating growth in Brazil’s B2B market.

This is a highly strategic and cross-functional role requiring deep ownership of ISG eCommerce processes. You will work closely with Brazil’s ISG 4P and Sales teams, as well as Lenovo’s global eCommerce organization, to deliver on revenue targets, shape the customer experience, and drive digital transformation within the ISG business.

You will own Brazil’s ISG eCommerce 4P strategy across Product, Price, Place, and Promotion, and be responsible for launching and managing performance marketing programs to generate leads, influence pipeline, and convert web traffic into sales. This is a unique opportunity to help build a business from the ground up and directly impact Lenovo’s global growth strategy.

Key Responsibilities

4P Strategy Ownership (Brazil ISG eCommerce)

  • Product: Define the ideal ISG eCommerce product portfolio (servers, storage, and options) for Lenovo.com in Brazil, in close collaboration with local 4P and global product and category teams.
  • Pricing: Lead Brazil-specific web pricing strategy, including promotions, deal structures, and competitive price factor value (PFV) benchmarking, in coordination with ISG Pricing and eCommerce operations.
  • Place: Position Lenovo.com.br as a key digital touchpoint for B2B ISG sales in Brazil, while supporting an integrated, omnichannel go-to-market approach in collaboration with channel partners.
  • Promotion: Develop and execute localized digital marketing demand generation campaigns aligned with ISG sales priorities, leveraging paid media, email, and account-based marketing.

Program Management & Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead Brazil’s ISG Web go-to-market planning, forecasting, and campaign execution in alignment with Sales, ISG 4P, Supply Chain, Channel/Reseller, and eCommerce teams.
  • Partner with Lenovo’s global eCommerce organization (site operations, merchandising, UX, BT/IT, and pricing operations) to deliver a best-in-class customer experience on Lenovo.com.br
  • Own and manage key business KPIs, including overall sales and profit contribution, web traffic, conversion rates, leads, ROAS and generated pipeline.

Market Activation & Reporting

  • Represent the Brazil ISG Web business in global strategy discussions and regular business reviews, ensuring alignment with broader ISG and eCommerce goals.
  • Serve as the local subject matter expert, surfacing market-specific needs, blockers, and growth opportunities to influence global strategy and investment planning.
  • Collaborate with Lenovo’s appointed digital agency to plan, execute, and optimize demand generation campaigns across SEM, paid social, and programmatic channels — ensuring media budgets are aligned to campaign goals and delivering measurable results.
  • Lead the creative briefing process, audience targeting strategy, localization requirements, and campaign calendar in collaboration with the agency and global marketing teams.
  • Monitor campaign performance, supporting continuous optimization through A/B testing, segmentation, and funnel analysis.
  • Provide ongoing reporting, insights, and strategic recommendations using marketing automation tools (e.g., BlueCore), web analytics, and Microsoft Dynamics.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • 6–10 years of experience in B2B marketing, product/portfolio management, or digital program leadership.
  • Proven track record of launching or scaling digital marketing and demand generation programs in Brazil or LATAM.
  • Strong understanding of Brazil’s B2B and IT infrastructure landscape.
  • Experience collaborating across functions such as Sales, Product Management, Pricing, and eCommerce.
  • Familiarity with servers, storage, or other data center infrastructure solutions is required.
  • Excellent communication, analytical, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and proficient in English.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, matrixed global environment with distributed teams.

Why Join Lenovo?

  • Collaborate with global leaders across marketing, sales, and digital commerce.
  • Competitive salary, performance incentives, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Join a culture that values innovation, inclusion, and agility.
